newsitem.title: UK: Five Brent dates clocked, one kept, one deferred.
newsitem.headline: Five Brent dates clocked, one kept, one deferred.

text.p: Five of the Brent dates nominated from the paper chains on Friday were clocked, one was kept and another deferred, traders said.

BP kept a cargo loading March 1-3, one was clocked to J.Aron and the other disputed between Nova and Koch. Glencore was clocked with a March 2-4 cargo, Elf and Mobil were in dispute over another, while a third was deferred. Tosco was clocked with a March 3-5 cargo, traders said.
The cargoes were the first from the March Brent loading programme to be nominated dates.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
